name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.MachinePickerActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this picker during a machine-transfer flow. It shows machines of the selected type, retains checked devices, and returns the selection to the calling page.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting machines for transfer.
